title: Add audio pipeline

context.summary: Add an audio processing path that writes derived transcript artifacts, time-coded segments and searchable chunks.
context.background: TASK-42 extracts WAV metadata and TASK-44/TASK-45 established modality-specific extractors. Audio routing still skips because no processor exists.

in: Route enabled audio uploads to document.extract.
Add a dedicated audio transcript extractor with deterministic metadata/embedded-text fallback behavior.
Create transcript derived artifacts and time-coded transcript segment spans.
Propagate transcript segment refs into chunk metadata and search source refs.
Record ASR model-runtime capability state without mutating RAW originals.
Add integration coverage for WAV upload, duration/codec metadata and transcript phrase search.
Update docs, validators and workspace wiring.
out: Audio waveform storage beyond the RAW original.

acceptance_criteria: Enabled audio routing creates a document.extract job.
Audio extraction writes a transcript artifact and time-coded transcript spans.
Chunk metadata/source refs include transcript artifacts and segment timing where applicable.
Audio document search returns source-backed hits for transcript text.
Audio duration and codec metadata filters continue to work through the metadata index.
Configured ASR capability state is recorded without mutating RAW originals.

manual_checks: Confirm audio search hits include transcript artifact metadata and timing refs.

risks: The MVP audio extractor uses deterministic metadata and embedded-text fallback until a real ASR adapter is installed.
Only basic WAV header metadata is available until richer audio probes are added.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
